name: Harry M. Von Sas & Son

hero.headline: Harry M. Von Sas & Son
hero.sub: Heating, cooling, and electrical work for Adams County homes and businesses.

items: Residential and light commercial electrical work
Emergency service calls for heating and cooling failures
Serving McSherrystown and the surrounding Adams County area
Licensed for both HVAC and electrical work
Straightforward quotes before any job starts
Comfortable working in homes and small commercial spaces alike

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Harry M. Von Sas & Son handles the two systems every property depends on: heating and cooling, and the electrical work behind them.
The crew shows up, diagnoses the actual problem, and quotes it plainly before starting any work.

items: Call for a quote and get a clear price before any work begins.
Licensed technicians handle both HVAC and electrical jobs.
Straight answers on what needs fixing now versus what can wait.

feature.heading: Heating and cooling that actually works
feature.text: From a dead furnace to a failing AC unit, the fix starts with an honest diagnosis, not a guess.

spotlight.heading: Electrical work, done to code
spotlight.text: Panel upgrades, wiring, and repairs handled by licensed electricians who know the local code.
